description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

Swaps faces in a supplied photo using a source face image or selected face mappings. Costs 10 credits; output size depends on subscription. Returns a project id for wait_for_image_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

assets.description: Provide the assets for face swap photo

face_mappings.description: This is the array of face mappings used for multiple face swap. The value is required if `face_swap_mode` is `individual-faces`.

image_index.description: Position in replacement_faces, starting at 1. Use exactly one attachment index or new_face.

new_face.description:
The face image that will be used to replace the face in the `original_face`. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

original_face.description:
The face detected from the image in `target_file_path`. The file name is in the format of `<face_frame>-<face_index>.png`. This value is corresponds to the response in the [face detection API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/get-face-detection-details).

* The face_frame is the frame number of the face in the target image. For images, the frame number is always 0.
* The face_index is the index of the face in the target image, starting from 0 going left to right.

face_swap_mode.description: Choose which faces to swap. `all-faces` uses one source image for all detected faces (`source_file_path` required). `individual-faces` uses exact `face_mappings`.

source_file_path.description:
This is the image from which the face is extracted. The value is required if `face_swap_mode` is `all-faces`.

This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

target_file_path.description:
This is the image where the face from the source image will be placed. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

replacement_faces.description: Attached image files. Set image_index in each matching entry to its position in this list, starting at 1.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS download URL supplied for the native ChatGPT attachment, including its signed query.

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the image. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the image(s), credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.
